name: update_listing
title: Update Listing
description: Create or modify the user's freeform Airsup20 listing via ChatGPT. Examples: sell a chair with price range and PayPal QR, add interest in tango, publish skills. Listing is user-controlled projection — never dump the whole knowledge/intent database into it.

note.description: Natural-language description of what to add or change.

patch.description: Freeform listing fields to merge (or replace if replace=true).

replace.description: If true, replace listing body with patch instead of merging.

media.description: Images/files from the user prompt if the host provided them.
